description: This Java source file defines a utility/helper class CalendarHelper used in integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to create, update, and verify calendar entities associated with groups, centers, and meetings within the system, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: CalendarHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to help with creating, updating, and verifying calendars used in integration tests of the Fineract platform.

methods.name: createMeetingCalendarForGroup
methods.description: Creates a meeting calendar for a specific group during testing, taking request specifications, response specifications, group ID, start date, and calendar recurrence parameters.

methods.name: updateMeetingCalendarForGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing meeting calendar for a group with new parameters.

methods.name: getTestCalendarAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing a calendar object with specified recurrence and start date, for testing purposes.

methods.name: verifyCalendarCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Fetches and verifies that a calendar has been successfully created on the server by comparing IDs.

methods.name: createMeetingForGroup
methods.description: Creates a meeting (calendar) for a group using the specified parameters.

methods.name: updateMeetingCalendarForCenter
methods.description: Updates a meeting calendar for a center with given parameters.

methods.name: getTestCalendarMeetingAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for rescheduling a meeting based on old and new dates.
